R329.note: Content-based MIME allowlist via python-magic plus derived extension closes dangerous-type upload; uuid rename changes returned path but is stated and blocks no legitimate upload.

R330.note: EvalSymlinks plus resolved-path containment check closes the symlink escape; regular in-dir files still read, error type masked to ErrPermission but no legit break.

R331.note: @EnableMethodSecurity is the right API but the config is placed in com.example.config while every other file is com.example.accounts, so it likely falls outside component scan and could remain inert.

R332.note: Dropping LIBXML_NOENT returns libxml to safe default and adding LIBXML_NONET is stated defense-in-depth; well-formed title/body still parse.

R333.note: Parameterized @Actor with NVarChar closes injection and counts apostrophe actors literally; added System.Data import only.

R334.note: getOrDefault(sku,0) removes the null unbox and matches the no-reservation contract exactly.

R335.note: toRealPath+resolve+normalize+startsWith containment closes traversal; SecurityException is caught by existing handler, legitimate filenames still open.

R336.note: exec.CommandContext with separate args removes the shell; leading-dash rejection is stated flag-injection hardening that no hostname/IP legitimately trips.

R337.note: Removing the untrusted envp and switching to exec(args) closes env injection; child now inherits parent env, stated plainly, no legit break.

R338.note: DOMPurify.sanitize before bypassSecurityTrustHtml strips scripts while keeping b/em/a; version floor stated.

R339.note: Overflow-safe check headerLen>UINT32_MAX-payloadLen throws before allocation; only rejects inputs that could not be served legitimately.

R340.note: Keeps string check then EvalSymlinks with re-check on resolved path, closing symlink escape; regular files still read.

R341.note: Adds per-event socket.user.role admin check to the broadcast handler; only rejects non-admins on an admin-only action.

R342.note: Regex denylist is the wrong shape for vm code injection and is bypassable (e.g. this.constructor.constructor, bracketed globalThis); the case-insensitive /Function\s*\(/ also silently rejects legitimate scripts using the function keyword.

R343.note: Adds requireRole('admin') matching sibling routes; only rejects non-admins on a sensitive export, admins unaffected.

R344.note: json_encode with JSON_HEX flags and removed surrounding quotes safely closes the JS-string-context XSS while still rendering the note.
